passage.text: On Monday, I got up at five o'clock and went jogging.
passage.reading: ɑːn ˈmʌndeɪ, aɪ ˈɡɑːt ˈʌp ət ˈfaɪv əˈklɑːk ənd ˈwɛnt ˈdʒɑːɡɪŋ.

passage.text: After school, I practiced badminton for three hours.
passage.reading: ˈæftər ˈskuːl, aɪ ˈpræktɪst ˈbædmɪntən fər ˈθriː ˈaʊərz.

passage.text: On Wednesday, I was very tired, and I played badly.
passage.reading: ɑːn ˈwɛnzdeɪ, aɪ wʌz ˈvɛri ˈtaɪərd, ənd aɪ ˈpleɪd ˈbædli.

passage.text: So on Thursday, I didn't practice.
passage.reading: soʊ ɑːn ˈθɜːrzdeɪ, aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈpræktɪs.

passage.text: I rested at home and went to bed early.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈrɛstɪd ət ˈhoʊm ənd ˈwɛnt tə ˈbɛd ˈɜːrli.

passage.text: On Saturday, I competed with the best young players in Thailand.
passage.reading: ɑːn ˈsætərdeɪ, aɪ kəmˈpiːtɪd wɪð ðə ˈbɛst ˈjʌŋ ˈpleɪərz ɪn ˈtaɪlænd.

passage.text: I won four games, and I got a medal!
passage.reading: aɪ ˈwʌn ˈfɔːr ˈɡeɪmz, ənd aɪ ˈɡɑːt ə ˈmɛdəl!

passage.text: My mom was very happy, and she cried.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈmɑːm wʌz ˈvɛri ˈhæpi, ənd ʃiː ˈkraɪd.

passage.text: Now my dream is to become a world champion.
passage.reading: ˈnaʊ maɪ ˈdriːm ɪz tə bɪˈkʌm ə ˈwɜːrld ˈtʃæmpiən.
